thread:
emily: dropped a quick prototype for a 'minimal rail' — icons-only collapsed by default, breadcrumb shows full path. figma: https://figma.redwood/nav/minimal-rail

kartik: looks tight. question about permalinks: do we keep workspace segments in the URL even when rail is iconified? e.g. /ws/44/model/x vs /model/x

sam: keep the full path canonical. analytics and shared links depend on predictable slugs. UI can be compact but URL should be explicit.

emily: plan: router resolves both shapes. if short form used, resolve workspace and replaceState to canonical long URL so back button isn't polluting history.

olga: agreed. implementation detail: use history.replaceState after resolving. also log an event when a short link was upgraded so we can track legacy traffic.

kartik: a11y: when rail is icons-only, each icon needs aria-label + visible focus ring. add a skip-to-main link. Breadcrumbs must be readable to screen readers with full labels, not just icons.

emily: also UX: when opening a deep link in a new tab, briefly render expanded rail or animate a reveal so users get context before it collapses. helps orientation for first-time viewers.

sam: copy nit: breadcrumbs should be humanized, e.g. 'Workspace: Payments › Model: pricing-v2' instead of raw slugs. Use the › separator for clarity.

olga: keyboard flow: tab into breadcrumb should focus the rightmost crumb. If its parent group is collapsed, focusing it should open that group or surface a mini-menu so keyboard users can continue.

kartik: tooltip vs persistent label: tooltips are fine for mouse, but for keyboard/screen reader we need an accessible label. consider a temporary visible label on first focus to aid discoverability.

emily: tests: add e2e for short+long deep links, unit test for resolver, and a usability check for open-in-new-tab state. I'll upload the two figma variants and an a11y checklist layer.

nav-bot: reminder: nav-usability slot Fri 11am. Please attach final frames to /boards/nav-ia before EOD Thu. :spiral_calendar:

emily: will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
